title: RYOT® SmellSafe™ Small PackRatz
description:
RYOT
®
SmellSafe™ Small PackRatz
We’ve redesigned the all new small PackRatz to better accommodate all your smoke and vaporizer needs. The all new small PackRatz now includes the trademark RYOT® Fresh Pod with freshness lining plus an extra pocket and dual zipper pulls. Whether storing glass, vapes, and anything in between, you’ll find this pocket sized, ultra-utilitarian case to be an indispensable part of your stash box.
RYOT
®
SmellSafe™
– is an activated carbon absorption technology where microscopic charcoal particles are fused together to create an odor protective barrier, blocking unwanted odors from escaping. Combined with our SmellSafe™ moisture seal zipper, RYOT® Pack and Protect™ has you ready to roll!
FEATURES:
Dimensions: 140 L x 92mm W x 25mm H
RYOT
®
SmellSafe
™
Technology
Odor absorption Antimicrobial microfibers
Pillow soft padding
Interior pocket ideal for vaporizers
Heavy duty exterior fabric
Removable, hi-tech freshness pod
Interior fold over pocket for cash, cards and ID
Lockable zipper for added security option (Lock not included)
Exterior fold over pocket
